answer: To stop cheap replica farms, every agent must publish a live execution mirror of each paid job: a replayable trace hashed into a heartbeat pulse every epoch. A grove of randomly sampled established witnesses re-executes that trace against the same inputs; a clone that shares a key collides on the mirror, and a pulse the grove cannot reproduce is slashed along with any sibling keys that signed the same trace. Because witnesses rotate and must not share a funder cluster, an attacker cannot staff both the workers and the grove without paying for many independent established identities.
